import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
from statsmodels.stats.multitest import multipletests
import sys
import time

print("=" * 60)
print("Gene Expression vs Essentiality: Spearman + BH analysis")
print("=" * 60)

# ── 1. Load data ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
t0 = time.time()

print("\nLoading CRISPR gene effect data...")
crispr = pd.read_csv(
    "/workspace/inputs/CRISPRGeneEffect.csv",
    index_col=0
)
print(f"  CRISPR shape: {crispr.shape}")
print(f"  Memory: {crispr.memory_usage(deep=True).sum() / 1e9:.2f} GB")

print("\nLoading expression data...")
expr = pd.read_csv(
    "/workspace/inputs/OmicsExpressionProteinCodingGenesTPMLogp1BatchCorrected.csv",
    index_col=0
)
print(f"  Expression shape: {expr.shape}")
print(f"  Memory: {expr.memory_usage(deep=True).sum() / 1e9:.2f} GB")

t1 = time.time()
print(f"\nLoad time: {t1 - t0:.1f}s")

# ── 2. Align cell lines ──────────────────────────────────────────
common_cells = crispr.index.intersection(expr.index)
print(f"\nCommon cell lines: {len(common_cells)}")

crispr = crispr.loc[common_cells]
expr = expr.loc[common_cells]

# ── 3. Align genes ───────────────────────────────────────────────
common_genes = crispr.columns.intersection(expr.columns)
print(f"Common genes: {len(common_genes)}")

crispr = crispr[common_genes]
expr = expr[common_genes]

n_genes = len(common_genes)
n_cells = len(common_cells)
print(f"Final data: {n_cells} cell lines × {n_genes} genes")

t2 = time.time()
print(f"Alignment time: {t2 - t1:.1f}s")

# ── 4. Convert to numpy for speed ─────────────────────────────────
# Ensure float64
crispr_arr = crispr.values.astype(np.float64)
expr_arr = expr.values.astype(np.float64)

# Check for any constant columns (no variance) — these give NaN p-values
crispr_var = np.nanvar(crispr_arr, axis=0)
expr_var = np.nanvar(expr_arr, axis=0)
valid_mask = (crispr_var > 0) & (expr_var > 0) & (~np.isnan(crispr_var)) & (~np.isnan(expr_var))
print(f"Genes with variance in both datasets: {valid_mask.sum()} / {n_genes}")

# ── 5. Compute Spearman correlations ─────────────────────────────
print("\nComputing Spearman correlations...")
pvals = np.full(n_genes, np.nan)
rhos = np.full(n_genes, np.nan)

batch_size = 500
for start in range(0, n_genes, batch_size):
    end = min(start + batch_size, n_genes)
    for i in range(start, end):
        if not valid_mask[i]:
            continue
        # Drop rows where either is NaN for this gene
        x = expr_arr[:, i]
        y = crispr_arr[:, i]
        mask = ~(np.isnan(x) | np.isnan(y))
        if mask.sum() < 10:  # Need minimum samples for meaningful correlation
            continue
        r, p = spearmanr(x[mask], y[mask])
        rhos[i] = r
        pvals[i] = p
    if (start // batch_size) % 10 == 0:
        elapsed = time.time() - t2
        print(f"  Processed {end}/{n_genes} genes ({elapsed:.1f}s elapsed)")

t3 = time.time()
print(f"Correlation time: {t3 - t2:.1f}s")

# ── 6. Filter out NaN p-values ────────────────────────────────────
valid_p = ~np.isnan(pvals)
print(f"\nGenes with valid p-values: {valid_p.sum()} / {n_genes}")

valid_pvals = pvals[valid_p]
valid_rhos = rhos[valid_p]
valid_gene_names = common_genes[valid_p]

# ── 7. Benjamini-Hochberg correction ─────────────────────────────
print("\nApplying Benjamini-Hochberg correction...")
reject, pvals_corrected, _, _ = multipletests(
    valid_pvals,
    alpha=0.05,
    method='fdr_bh'
)
